generate_docstring: generate a docstring for an ExecutableSpec factory method from its class docstring
generate_factory_parameters: generate factory method parameters from ExecutableSpec constructor parameters
generate_factory_method: generate a factory method source code for a given ExecutableSpec type
run_packagables_generator: run the packagables_generator CLI to print factory methods for all ExecutableSpec types
summarize_packagables_generator: summarize the packagables_generator utility that generates factory methods for packagables.py
